label: Short-run advertising elasticity
source: Sethuraman, Tellis and Briesch, Journal of Marketing Research 2011 (751 short-run and 402 long-run estimates from 56 studies); 0.09 from a later international meta-analysis

label: Bass coefficient of innovation p
source: Sultan, Farley and Lehmann, JMR 1990, meta-analysis of 213 parameter sets; 0.10 reflects heavy advertising in the generalized Bass model

label: Bass coefficient of imitation q
source: Sultan, Farley and Lehmann, JMR 1990

label: Campaign awareness in the new ring
source: State tourism ROI studies at higher per-capita spend: Washington 36% (SMARI FY2024), New Mexico 44% (Longwoods 2015), North Dakota 47%

label: Incremental visit rate among aware residents
source: Washington: 77,000 incremental trips from 2.4M aware households (3.2% per household, ~1.3% per resident); Wyoming: likelihood to visit 7% unaware to 14% aware (Longwoods 2019)

label: Share of 2025 visits from the neighboring ring
source: Verified visitor-origin surveys: Bolton Food and Drink Festival 72% local postcode; Big Sur Food and Wine 70% Monterey County; promoter claims of 60-80% out-of-region are rarely verified (Stratford Analytics)

label: Huff distance-decay exponent
source: Esri Huff model documentation: usually ranges between 1.5 and 2

label: Milestone anniversary lift net of marketing and concert
source: Disneyland 2014-2016 attendance 16.769M / 18.278M / 17.943M (TEA/AECOM); Disneyland 50th +8.5% vs top-50 parks +4.2% (Amusement Business/ERA 2005); Musikfest 40th 1.33M vs prior record 1.24M (Morning Call 2023); Indy 500 100th running sellout (2016)

label: Saturday share of a weekend
source: Minnesota State Fair first-weekend Saturday vs Sunday: 198,842 vs 171,054 (2022); 198,863 vs 184,176 (2023); 184,564 vs 134,644 (2024)

label: Season weather multiplier
source: Minnesota State Fair 2024: one rain day at 81,231 against a normal day near 135,000 (about 40% loss); one washed-out day of eight is 5% of the season

label: Paid ticket conversion of metro monthly listeners
source: insights.live: roughly 1% to 3% of an artist's monthly listeners in a metro convert to ticket buyers; Orphiq: 2% working estimate for tour routing

label: Conversion when the show is free with admission
source: Team assumption: five times the paid working estimate because the marginal price of the show is zero

label: Apple Music listeners as a ratio of Spotify monthly listeners
source: Spotify ~37% and Apple Music ~31% of US subscribers (Digital Music News Aug 2025; DemandSage), but Spotify listener counts include free users (751M MAU vs 290M paid, Q4 2025)

label: No-show rate at free events
source: VenueSight via eventcloud: free events routinely lose 40 to 60% of registrants; Eventbrite: as high as 50%

label: Share of fairgoers who attend every year
source: New York State Fair 2015 exit survey: four out of five are regular patrons; 30% attend multiple times

label: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Sept 2026 vs Sept 2025)
source: UMich Surveys of Consumers, September 2026 final 48.1; September 2025 55.1; one-year inflation expectations 4.6%

label: National average regular gasoline (Sept 24-25 2026)
source: AAA national average $4.49 on Sept 24-25 2026, highest ever for this time of year; about 25% above a year ago (Empower/AAA Sept 3 2026)

label: Short-run price elasticity of gasoline demand
source: Hughes, Knittel and Sperling, Energy Journal 2008 (NBER w12530): -0.034 to -0.077 for 2001-2006, versus -0.21 to -0.34 in 1975-1980

label: Elasticity of discretionary day trips to fuel cost
source: Team assumption: discretionary leisure trips are more elastic than total gasoline demand; bracketed above the Hughes-Knittel-Sperling range

label: Local attendance lift from staycation substitution in a weak economy
source: 2009 recession: fairs reported booming business as families passed up out-of-town trips; Salem Fair ticket and food sales +25% (NBC News Aug 2009); Minnesota State Fair set its then all-time record in 2009 (CBS Minnesota 2014)

label: Real per-guest spend change from trade-down
source: Minnesota State Fair 2025: attendance up even as fairgoers say they visit less often and spend less due to rising prices (Star Tribune Sept 1 2025); retail sales still +6.0% y/y nominal in Aug 2026

label: Net macro multiplier on attendance
source: Derived in macro.py: staycation lift on the local ring, fuel-cost drag on the outer ring, small sentiment drag
